transcript.answer: Otto PR #475, "Hand the resolved fallback to HAL Engine, and refuse fallbacks it cannot serve". It closes issue #474 and was merged on 2026-10-23. Earlier, PR #438 (issue #179) had only checked FALLBACK_MODEL_ID against the allowlist and printed it in the api.model startup line. It never passed the fallback to the engine. PR #475 added `supportAgentProviders` in apps/api/src/server.ts, which gives `createHalEngine` a `fallbackProviders` list. That list holds the resolved fallback when one is configured and is empty otherwise.
